review_findings: The capture log and contemporaneous STATE record describe one researcher self-test and one uncontrolled pilot fall sample.
The automatic label file contains two nearby motion fragments, both stamped fall, but supplies no independent human adjudication for two separate falls.
The fragments have opposite Doppler direction signs and their centered three-second analysis windows overlap, consistent with phases of one episode or fall/recovery rather than two independent falls.
Class truth for each fragment remains unresolved; neither fragment may be used to manufacture a detection success criterion.
resolution_required: Independent source-grounded human adjudication or a new protocol-controlled recording with episode and phase annotations.
